I am the Director of Teaching and Learning in the Department of Computer Science at the University of Chicago.

I stepped into this role recently, and will have more details available soon. In a nutshell, my role is to support anyone in the department with teaching responsibilities, from the tenure-line faculty to the undergraduate TAs.

To better inform what kinds of support we should offer in our department, I have been running a study on how Computer Science departments in the US support their teaching activities: [Support for Teaching Activities in Computer Science Departments at US R1 Universities](cs-teaching-support-study.qmd). The study is still recruiting interview subjects, and that page has details on how to participate.
